## Reporting Security Issues

Please do not report security issues in public issues or on the forum. Use the **Report a vulnerability** button on the Security tab of the repository instead. Your report stays private. If you cannot use GitHub, email me at [david@grudl.com](mailto:david@grudl.com) and include the word "SECURITY" in the subject line.

I take security bugs very seriously. If you don't hear from me within a week, please ping me. Once I accept the report, a fix should be available and a new version released within days. I will make the bug public once a new version is released or the report is declined.

## Supported Versions

I support each minor version of a package (for example 3.1) for at least two years after its first stable release. The newest one gets all fixes, older ones get security fixes only. You can see which versions are supported at [nette.org/en/maintenance](https://nette.org/en/maintenance).
